means: It does not fade. Five separate 2x arms across about 2h20m of wall clock, from 21:05 to 23:20, every one of them non-zero, pooled 25 of 44. windows-desk reports its suite-context lever no longer firing at all and mac-bench's faded in the same window; this one has been reproducible on demand all session.
not_claimed: That the contention lever will not fade too. Five arms over one session is not a guarantee, and the honest comparison is that nobody has yet seen it fail to fire rather than that it cannot.
why_it_matters: Whoever investigates this next should use the contention lever rather than the context lever, because it is the one that can be turned on. Two benches have now had experiments go void because their lever stopped between the arm and its control - windows-desk's promotion experiment was exactly that.
